name: annotations
create_table_query: CREATE TABLE telemetry.annotations (`organization_id` String DEFAULT '', `workspace_id` String DEFAULT '', `identity_state` Enum8('unattributed' = 0, 'verified' = 1, 'platform' = 2) DEFAULT 'unattributed', `identity_version` UInt8 DEFAULT 0, `id` UUID DEFAULT generateUUIDv4(), `trace_id` String, `span_id` String, `name` String, `label` Nullable(String), `score` Nullable(Float64), `explanation` Nullable(String), `metadata` String DEFAULT '{}', `annotator_kind` LowCardinality(String) DEFAULT 'HUMAN', `source` LowCardinality(String) DEFAULT 'API', `created_at` DateTime64(3) DEFAULT now64(3), `updated_at` DateTime64(3) DEFAULT now64(3), CONSTRAINT valid_verified_scope CHECK (identity_state != 'verified') OR ((identity_version = 1) AND (toUUIDOrNull(organization_id) IS NOT NULL) AND (toUUIDOrNull(workspace_id) IS NOT NULL) AND (organization_id = toString(toUUIDOrNull(organization_id))) AND (workspace_id = toString(toUUIDOrNull(workspace_id))) AND (organization_id != '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND (workspace_id != '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree(updated_at) ORDER BY (organization_id, workspace_id, identity_state, identity_version, trace_id, span_id, name, id) TTL toDateTime(created_at) + toIntervalDay(90) SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192

name: error_logs
create_table_query: CREATE TABLE telemetry.error_logs (`organization_id` String, `workspace_id` String, `identity_state` Enum8('unattributed' = 0, 'verified' = 1, 'platform' = 2), `identity_version` UInt8, `Timestamp` DateTime64(9), `ServiceName` LowCardinality(String), `SeverityText` LowCardinality(String), `Body` String, `TraceId` String, `SpanId` String, `LogAttributes` Map(LowCardinality(String), String)) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY toDate(Timestamp) ORDER BY (organization_id, workspace_id, identity_state, identity_version, Timestamp) TTL toDateTime(Timestamp) + toIntervalDay(30) SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192

name: error_logs_ingest
create_table_query: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW telemetry.error_logs_ingest TO telemetry.error_logs (`organization_id` String, `workspace_id` String, `identity_state` Enum8('unattributed' = 0, 'verified' = 1, 'platform' = 2), `identity_version` UInt8, `Timestamp` DateTime64(9), `ServiceName` LowCardinality(String), `SeverityText` LowCardinality(String), `Body` String, `TraceId` String, `SpanId` String, `LogAttributes` Map(LowCardinality(String), String)) AS SELECT organization_id, workspace_id, identity_state, identity_version, Timestamp, ServiceName, SeverityText, Body, TraceId, SpanId, LogAttributes FROM telemetry.logs WHERE SeverityText IN ('ERROR', 'FATAL', 'CRITICAL')

name: error_spans
create_table_query: CREATE TABLE telemetry.error_spans (`organization_id` String, `workspace_id` String, `identity_state` Enum8('unattributed' = 0, 'verified' = 1, 'platform' = 2), `identity_version` UInt8, `Timestamp` DateTime64(9), `ServiceName` LowCardinality(String), `SpanName` LowCardinality(String), `TraceId` String, `SpanId` String, `Duration` Int64, `StatusCode` LowCardinality(String), `StatusMessage` String, `SpanAttributes` Map(LowCardinality(String), String)) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY toDate(Timestamp) ORDER BY (organization_id, workspace_id, identity_state, identity_version, Timestamp) TTL toDateTime(Timestamp) + toIntervalDay(30) SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192

name: event_counts
create_table_query: CREATE TABLE telemetry.event_counts (`organization_id` String DEFAULT '', `workspace_id` String DEFAULT '', `identity_state` Enum8('unattributed' = 0, 'verified' = 1, 'platform' = 2) DEFAULT 'unattributed', `identity_version` UInt8 DEFAULT 0, `timestamp_hour` DateTime, `source_type` String, `event_type` String, `status` String, `count` UInt64, CONSTRAINT valid_verified_scope CHECK (identity_state != 'verified') OR ((identity_version = 1) AND (toUUIDOrNull(organization_id) IS NOT NULL) AND (toUUIDOrNull(workspace_id) IS NOT NULL) AND (organization_id = toString(toUUIDOrNull(organization_id))) AND (workspace_id = toString(toUUIDOrNull(workspace_id))) AND (organization_id != '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND (workspace_id != '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))) ENGINE = SummingMergeTree(count) ORDER BY (organization_id, workspace_id, identity_state, identity_version, timestamp_hour, source_type, event_type, status) TTL timestamp_hour + toIntervalDay(7) SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192

name: event_counts_ingest
create_table_query: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW telemetry.event_counts_ingest TO telemetry.event_counts (`organization_id` String, `workspace_id` String, `identity_state` Enum8('unattributed' = 0, 'verified' = 1, 'platform' = 2), `identity_version` UInt8, `timestamp_hour` DateTime, `source_type` String, `event_type` String, `status` String, `count` UInt64) AS SELECT organization_id, workspace_id, identity_state, identity_version, toStartOfHour(Timestamp) AS timestamp_hour, LogAttributes['event.source_type'] AS source_type, LogAttributes['event.type'] AS event_type, LogAttributes['status'] AS status, count() AS count FROM telemetry.logs WHERE (LogAttributes['event.id']) != '' GROUP BY organization_id, workspace_id, identity_state, identity_version, timestamp_hour, source_type, event_type, status
